terminals.name: gateway-server
terminals.command: bash -c 'until (exec 3<>/dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/8064) 2>/dev/null; do sleep 1; done; exec godot --headless --path . --mode=gateway-server'

terminals.name: world-server
terminals.command: bash -c 'until (exec 3<>/dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/8062) 2>/dev/null; do sleep 1; done; exec godot --headless --path . --mode=world-server'
